mentions.name: DOS-style TUI for Markdown Vaults
mentions.description: A FOSS terminal user interface (TUI) for working with Obsidian-style markdown vaults, built around interaction metaphors from classic DOS software, particularly WordPerfect 6 and Norton Commander.
mentions.source_excerpt: A FOSS TUI for Obsidian-like markdown Vaults, using interactiong metaphors of old DOS software. Especially inspired by Wordperfect 6 and Norton Commander.
mentions.author: delgaudm
